candidate_stops.screening: Each source is linked to an existing OSM highway node within 100 m, excludes explicitly restricted/prohibited bicycle source and linked-way access, and must be structurally reachable from and able to return to the Lotus Tower anchor while honoring mapped bicycle direction. Missing/default access remains unresolved; turn restrictions are not applied.
candidate_stops.status: Candidates only; no stopping legality, access permission, curb condition, operating hours, or safety was manually or field validated.

definitions.context: Circle of 1,500 m radius around the same center; includes the core.
definitions.core: Circle of 1,000 m radius around the verified OSM Lotus Tower way center.
definitions.intersection: Shared OSM node with at least three distinct adjacent graph nodes. Geometric crossings without a shared node are not joined.
definitions.mapped_zero: A zero count means no matching feature is mapped in this snapshot; it does not confirm real-world absence.
definitions.physical_road_group_estimate: Connected components of ways sharing a normalized name, ref, or (when unnamed) highway class; a heuristic, not a surveyed road count.
definitions.road_way: Distinct OSM way carrying a highway tag and intersecting the stated circular area.
definitions.routing_buffer: The 500 m annulus between the core and context boundaries.

initial_route.assumptions: Shortest paths on mapped highway centerlines, honoring supported bicycle direction tags. Missing/default access is unresolved; conditional direction is structurally bidirectional; turn restrictions, curb legality, surface, safety, and field conditions are not applied or validated.

projection.name: local spherical azimuthal equidistant
projection.precision_note: Spherical local analysis, not WGS84 ellipsoidal survey precision.

restrictions.completeness_definition: At least one from, to, and via member and every member reference present in the snapshot.

bicycle.assumption: Honours mapped oneway direction (including -1 and bicycle overrides) but does not apply access restrictions or turn relations.

motor_vehicle.assumption: Honours mapped oneway direction (including -1 and bicycle overrides) but does not apply access restrictions or turn relations.

bicycle.assumption: Includes only ways with an explicit allowed tag for the mode; unresolved missing/default and conditional access are excluded.

topology.legal_routing_status: Not validated: no turn restrictions are applied and mapped tags do not confirm current legal or physical access.
